title: Refresh in UI causing error
body:

Other

comments.author: hanslemm
comments.body:
Since Airbyte is not accepting contributions at [Airbyte Platform Repo](https://github.com/airbytehq/airbyte-platform/tree/main), I had to create my [fork](https://github.com/hanslemm/airbyte-platform) and build a custom image for `airbyte-server` pod.

The issue is in the `WebappFilter.kt`. What my [changes](https://github.com/airbytehq/airbyte-platform/compare/main...hanslemm:airbyte-platform:main?expand=1)(check file changes tab) does:
- Before: HttpRequest.create(...) returned a Netty client request; when Micronaut Security’s CookieTokenReader runs on SPA refresh (where copy() is used), it calls getCookies() and hits UnsupportedOperationException.
- Now: SimpleHttpRequest implements server-side request behaviors (cookies parsed via headers), so CookieTokenReader can read cookies without error. The rest of WebappFilter (CSP/Last-Modified and redirects) is unchanged.

My custom image with the fix is [here](https://hub.docker.com/repository/docker/hlemm/airbyte-server/tags) while Airbyte doesn't patch it.
